summary: SRanger controller implemented: 3 modes, 7 transitions (SR-Beh1..7), 2 named predicates, Sensor/Clock/Actuator leaves, 23/23 requirements traced. 8 items flagged: 2 invented defaults, 4 design choices, 1 scope question, 1 ambiguity. Nothing unimplemented.

issues.title: No-reading IR distance is 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 requires a 'large default value' when no reading is available but gives no number.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor returns NO_READING_DISTANCE = 1000.0 m before the first valid reading and after an invalid (negative or NaN) one, far above obstacleThreshold = 0.5 m. Change the constant if the platform defines a sentinel.

issues.title: Actuator holds Move(0, 0) before the first command
issues.raw: SR-DM6 does not say what the actuator reports before any command is issued.
issues.fix_directive: The actuator starts at (0.0, 0.0) (stationary). The controller constructor overwrites it straight away with Move(moveVel, 0), so no observable cycle uses it.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning needs both the obstacle event and obstacleDetected
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 triggers on the obstacle event; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected (distance <= obstacleThreshold) is the guard of the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as trigger obstacle with condition obstacleDetected. An obstacle event without a reading at or below the threshold is ignored in Moving.

issues.title: Turning priority: endTask, then the autonomous timeout, then tick
issues.raw: SR-Beh5/6/7 all have priority 1. tick is delivered every cycle, so if tick came before the timeout Turning would never be left.
issues.fix_directive: endTask is first (override); the autonomous turnDurationElapsed branch comes next; the tick self-loop is guarded by !turnDurationElapsed so the two are mutually exclusive in the model.

issues.title: Initial Move(moveVel, 0) is issued in the constructor
issues.raw: SR-FR1 requires Move(moveVel, 0) on entering Moving, and SR-Beh1 says the controller starts in Moving; no transition into the initial mode exists in step().
issues.fix_directive: The constructor issues Move(moveVel, 0) once. Every transition into Moving inside step() issues it too. The extracted model may not include this power-up action, because the profile places entry actions only inside step() branches.

issues.title: Clock is a framework-advanced time source in seconds
issues.raw: SR-Var1 requires 'the current time' but does not name a time source.
issues.fix_directive: Clock.now() returns seconds since start-up; the system framework calls Clock.advance(dt). clockResetTime = timer.now() on Moving -> Turning; turnDurationElapsed is timer.now() - clockResetTime >= turnDuration (extracted as since(clockResetTime)).

issues.title: obstacleThreshold = 0.5 is rounded up to 1 in the model
issues.raw: The model's constants interface rounds a fractional constant up to an integer; obstacleThreshold is used in the obstacleDetected guard.
issues.fix_directive: The Java guard uses 0.5 m; the verified model checks distance() <= 1. Deadlock and divergence results do not depend on the value, but any property that depends on the exact threshold does not carry over. The other three constants are integral.

issues.title: When the timeout fires, and what Turning/Final do with other events
issues.raw: SR-Beh5 says the transition fires when turnDurationElapsed 'becomes true'; nothing says what obstacle does in Turning or what any event does in Final.
issues.fix_directive: In Java the timeout is evaluated at each step() call, so it fires on the first cycle at or after turnDuration. obstacle in Turning, and every event in Final, is ignored. No transitions were invented for them.
